scripts.setup: node scripts/criar-env.mjs && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:push: prisma db push && npm run db:rls
scripts.db:rls: prisma db execute --file prisma/rls.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db execute --file prisma/empresas.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.banco:copiar: node scripts/com-tunel.mjs node --env-file=.env.producao scripts/copiar-banco.mjs && node --env-file=.env scripts/carregar-copia.mjs
